info.title: Console Gyro Bridge
info.author: Pianist13r
info.description: Use the Switch console's gyro for handheld motion controls
info.details: Tilt the Switch console to control motion-enabled games in handheld mode, including with controllers that have no motion sensors. This Atmosphère sysmodule supplies the console's gyro readings when the game requests motion and the controller has no active motion input. Buttons and sticks work as usual.\n\nReboot into Atmosphère after installing, then enable motion controls in a supported game. To disable the module, remove atmosphere/contents/4200000000475952/flags/boot2.flag from the SD card and reboot.

changelog: Improves sensor handoff when switching between games. Removes runtime diagnostic logging.
